en: Arise, and be known henceforth as Lady Elara of the Vale.
tr: Kalk ve bundan böyle Vadi Hanımı Elara olarak tanın.

en: Let sleeping dogs lie, my friend.
Speak of the devil, here he comes.
The temple bells fell silent on the night of the plague.
Let us not squabble while the kingdom burns.
All parties are hereby summoned to appear in court.
tr: Tüm tarafların mahkemeye çıkması için çağrısı yapılmıştır.

en: They're closing in on us from all sides.
You owe me, and I always collect.
tr: Borcun var bana, ben de her zaman tahsilimi alırım.

en: Not so brave now, are you?
tr: Şimdi pek cesur değilsin, değil mi?

en: I slept like a log last night.
The verdict cannot be appealed.
It's all hands on deck, people!
You really put your foot in it this time.
He got what was coming to him.
Count the chips, the house always wins.
tr: Çipleri say, kasanın kazandığı her zaman bellidir.

en: Ease the door open and peek inside.
tr: Kapıyı hafifçe arala ve içeriye bir göz at.

en: The fortress has never fallen, and it never shall.
tr: Kale hiç düşmedi, asla düşmeyecek de.

en: Steady as she goes, boys.
He ate his words.
A stitch in time saves nine.
tr: Zamanında alınan önlem, sonradan büyük işlere yol açmaz.

en: Bandage the wound to stop the bleeding.
I trusted you, and you stabbed me in the back.
tr: Sana güvendim, sen de arkamdan vurdun.

en: The thief stole the painting right off the wall.
The crown prince shall wed before the harvest.
tr: Veliaht prens hasat vaktinden önce evlenecek.

en: They fought like cats and dogs.
Better luck next time, rookie.
That bridge is burned for good.
He hit me below the belt.
You look like crap.
Patience is a virtue, kid.
The sword sings when evil is near.
Seal the tunnel behind us.
Trade your furs for supplies at the post.
Use the vents to get to the control room.
tr: Kontrol odasına ulaşmak için havalandırmaları kullan.

en: Yo, I got your back, fam.
Wow, you're even uglier up close.
tr: Vay canına, yakından daha da çirkinsin.

en: He's a fair-weather friend.
Make a run for the truck on my count.
I'm up to my neck in work.
The cult worships a being older than time itself.
tr: Tarikat, zamanın kendisinden bile daha eski bir varlığa tapıyor.

en: Wherefore dost thou tarry, good sir?
I'm shaking like a leaf.
You expect me to swallow that story?
He's mad cool, that dude.
A trial by jury of one's peers is the right of every citizen.
tr: Her vatandaşın kendi akranları önünde yargılanma hakkı vardır.

en: Ugh, that smells disgusting.
tr: Öf, ne kadar kötü kokuyor ya.

en: Death comes for us all in the end.
The accountant cooked the books for years before anyone noticed.
tr: Muhasebeci kimse fark etmeden yıllarca defterleri karaladı.

en: Objection, Your Honour. The question is leading.
tr: İtiraz ediyorum Sayın Hakim. Bu soru yönlendirici.

en: Collect ten pelts and bring them to the trader.
tr: On tane kürk topla ve tüccara götür.

en: Back me up on this one.
Swing across on the rope.
He who sheds innocent blood shall be cursed for all eternity.
tr: Masum kan dökenin laneti sonsuza dek sürer.

en: Jeez, give me a second to breathe!
We can do this the easy way or the hard way.
tr: İster usulüne uygun yapalım, ister zor yoldan.

en: The soldiers laid down their arms one by one.
Let that be a lesson. Never trust a thief.
tr: Bunu dersin olsun. Asla hırsıza güvenme.

en: Watch out for the rotten planks!
He's lost his marbles.
Alright, big boy, let's see what you've got.
tr: Hadi bakalım büyük adam, görelim bakalım ne yapabiliyorsun.

en: I need a new identity and a one-way ticket out of here.
tr: Yeni bir kimliğe ve buradan tek yönlü bir biletle kaçışa ihtiyacım var.

en: Looking sharp, boss!
You are entitled to a fair hearing.
We showed them who's boss!
Dig in; reinforcements are on the way.
The vault has two layers of security, so go slow.
tr: Hazinenin iki katmanlı güvenliği var, o yüzden yavaş ilerle.

en: The council made a mountain out of a molehill.
tr: Konseyin yaptığı şey, samanlıkta saman aramak gibiydi.

en: Don't get your hopes up.
Hear me out before you decide.
tr: Karar vermeden önce beni bir dinle.

en: Think it over and give me your answer tomorrow.
tr: Biraz düşün de cevabını yarın ver.

en: Mind your own business, stranger.
Look at this guy, all swagger and no brains.
tr: Şu tipe bak, boş boş hava atıyor ama kılıfı yok.

en: The race is going to come down to the wire.
tr: Yarış son ana kadar kafa kafaya gidecek.

en: Don't give up on me now.
Approach from behind and press Q for a silent takedown.
tr: Arkadan yaklaş ve sessizce etkisiz hale getirmek için Q tuşuna bas.

en: Put your money where your mouth is.
Lay low until the heat dies down.
That's fire, no cap.
Shoot, I plum forgot.
Lock on to a target with the middle mouse button.
tr: Orta fare düğmesiyle bir hedefe kilitlen.

en: And so the legend of the lost king was born.
The crowd is cheering as the drivers line up at the start.
tr: Sürücüler başlangıç çizgisinde dizilirken kalabalık coşkuyla tezahürat yapıyor.

en: The old fortress stood the test of time.
tr: Eski kale zamanın yıpratıcı etkisine direnmiş.

en: Make it look like an accident.
He's the kind of man who never forgets a face.
tr: Gördüğü yüzü asla unutmayan bir adamdır.

en: Chopper's inbound. Get to the landing zone.
The enemy would not give an inch.
I've been working my fingers to the bone.
Everybody on the ground, now!
Walls have ears. Speak softly.
Stick around, you might learn something.
tr: Buralarda takıl, belki bir şeyler öğrenirsin.

en: Crap, I think I broke it.
Keep your enemies close and your friends closer.
tr: Düşmanını yakın tut, dostunu daha yakın.

en: Finish him!
Where were you on the night of the fifteenth?
The fight was fixed, and everyone knew it.
tr: Dövüş ayarlanmıştı, herkes de bunu biliyordu.

en: Return to the elder to claim your reward.
tr: Ödülünü almak için yaşlıya geri dön.

en: The cops finally nailed him after ten years of chasing.
tr: Polisler on yıllık kovalamacanın ardından sonunda onu köşeye sıkıştırdı.

en: Moving up. Cover me.
Report any suspicious activity immediately.
tr: Şüpheli bir durum fark ederseniz hemen bildirin.

en: He's as dumb as a box of rocks.
Stop playing games with me.
Bring me three bottles of rum and I'll tell you everything.
tr: Bana üç şişe rom getir, her şeyi anlatayım.

en: I'll draw their fire while you go around.
tr: Sen arkadan dolanırken ben dikkatlerini üzerime çekerim.

en: Never accept the first offer.
These words were carved by the first priests of the sun.
tr: Bu sözleri güneşin ilk rahipleri kazımış.

en: I'd bet my head on it.
Stop being a coward and fight me.
tr: Korkaklık yapmayı bırak da karşıma çık.

en: He showed off in front of everyone.
The messenger was the bearer of bad news.
Out of my way, you nitwit!
Let none say that the throne was taken without a fight.
tr: Tahtın kavgasız alındığını kimse iddia etmesin.

en: The prisoner has requested a trial by combat.
Stay in your lane, little man.
Don't judge a book by its cover. He's tougher than he looks.
tr: Dış görünüşe aldanma. Göründüğünden çok daha dişli biri.

en: He's the cream of the crop.
Start the engine and let it warm up.
Our rivals hit us hard last night, and now we hit back.
tr: Dün gece bize sağlam vurdular, şimdi sıra bizde.

en: I'll bring my A-game tonight.
tr: Bu gece elimden gelenin en iyisini yapacağım.

en: Area cleared. You may proceed.
Hold your horses, we're not ready yet.
Dude, you're so extra.
Sweep the building and report back.
Get your act together, or we lose.
She's still bitter about what happened.
The dice are loaded.
Well, I'll swan. That's a big ol' gator.
tr: Vay canına! Bu ne kadar büyük bir timsah öyle.

en: Anything you say can and will be used against you.
tr: Söylediğiniz her şey aleyhinize kullanılabilir ve kullanılacaktır.

en: Let bygones be bygones.
Dying is easy. Living is the hard part.
I've got butterflies in my stomach.
Give me a boost; I can't reach the ledge.
